productDetail.messengerQuestion: Questions or a large order? Message us on Messenger
productDetail.storageText: Keep refrigerated. Best enjoyed within 24 hours.
productDetail.promiseText: Cakes are made fresh to order, so we can't refund a change of mind. If something is wrong with your order, send us a photo within 2 hours of delivery and we'll make it right with a fresh cake or a coupon.
